name: infra
description: Typed subprocess actuation: wraps the docker, git, and nix CLIs behind clean Go interfaces with structured I/O, builds immutable images from pinned Nix package sets, and provides the container-run primitive that assembles a docker run argv from binding contributions.

requirements.title: Typed subprocess interfaces
requirements.description: All external tool invocations (docker, git, nix, user-supplied resolver and data-source commands) go through typed Go interfaces backed by os/exec, using the tools' structured output modes (docker --format json, git plumbing, nix --json) — never free-text stdout scraping; docker exec, with and without the operator's terminal, and the inspect-based running query are among those verbs. Every interface accepts a context.Context and is fakeable in tests.

requirements.title: Nix image build
requirements.description: Build a template's image with Nix dockerTools.buildLayeredImage from its pinned package list; load the result into the docker daemon with a deterministic tag derived from the template name and toolset hash. The nixpkgs pin is resolved per build — the toolset's optional pin, else faber's compiled-in default — and the resolved pin folds into the toolset hash, the rendered expression, and the resolution proof (a pin-less build is byte-identical to the default). Custom binaries enter via a user-supplied overlay of derivations. No Dockerfile; no repository content in the image, but the engine's own static inputs are: the faber-box entry binary and the template's in-box hook scripts and skills tree enter as one image layer, their bytes fold into the toolset hash, and a faber upgrade or a hook or skill edit is a rebuild; packages are root-owned and immutable at runtime.

requirements.title: Package resolution proof
requirements.description: At validate time, prove every name in a template's package list resolves in the pinned nixpkgs (nix eval), without building. Unresolvable names are validate-time errors carrying the template and package name.

requirements.title: Container run primitive
requirements.description: Run one step container: assemble the docker run argv from the image, resource limits, the ordered binding contributions supplied by the security module, mounts (no host path: the entry binary, the hook scripts and the skills tree are image content, the result dir is a tmpfs, a template's volumes are docker named volumes), and environment; when the binding set carries a file-mode secrets payload, attach the container's stdin (-i) and stream that payload in; start, wait, and return exit code plus captured output, keeping the container's two streams apart — stderr (with docker's own messages) is the human log, tee'd into the caller's optional durable writer (ContainerSpec.Output), stdout is the box's frame stream, passed untouched to the caller's Stdout writer. Supports kill on context cancellation, a caller-supplied attach started beside the container and cancelled when it ends (the identity relay over exec), and entering a held box for the operator (run detached, attach, receive a stream over exec, attach the terminal over exec, kill). --rm by default; one container per step invocation, no reuse.

requirements.title: Deferred: image GC and cache eviction
requirements.description: Backlog (design edge case 11): garbage-collect Nix store paths and docker images left behind by superseded toolsets; define retention policy and a faber-owned cleanup command. First pass relies on manual docker/nix GC.

components.name: ExecAdapters
components.description: The typed CLI adapters: DockerClient (run with two output writers, exec, exec with the terminal attached, kill, remove, the image, network and running queries, the volume list and remove verbs), GitClient, NixClient, and CommandRunner (for opaque user commands). Each adapter maps a small set of verbs to argv, parses structured output into Go types, wraps errors with the invoked command context, and honors context deadlines.

components.name: ImageBuilder
components.description: The Nix build pipeline: renders the buildLayeredImage expression from a template's package list, overlay, resolved nixpkgs pin and the engine's static inputs (faber-box, the in-box hook scripts, the skills tree, staged beside the expression and read once) (the toolset's optional per-image pin, else the compiled-in default, mapped config.PinDef -> infra.NixpkgsPin at the boundary), evaluates package resolution at validate time, builds and loads the image, and computes the deterministic tag. Owns the deferred GC/retention seam.

components.name: ContainerRunner
components.description: The single-step container lifecycle: argv assembly from image, limits, binding contributions, the engine's writable mounts (the workspace volume and the result, bundle, tmp and home tmpfs; never a host bind), and env (the entry binary, hooks and skills are image content); the optional file-mode secrets payload streamed on the container's stdin; run, wait, the stderr captured as the human log and the stdout passed through as the box's frame stream, kill-on-cancel; and Enter, the hold-receive-attach-kill choreography that puts the operator inside a reconstructed box without a mount. The only place a docker run is ever constructed.

data_flows.name: Template to image to container
data_flows.description: TemplateDef packages -> nix eval proof -> buildLayeredImage -> docker load (tagged image) -> ContainerRunner argv (image + bindings + mounts) -> running step container -> exit code and captured output.
